records.original_sql:
SELECT
    regexp_extract(pushed, 'in=([0-9]+)', 1)::INT AS in_count,
    pushed NOT LIKE '%rng=none%' AS has_range
FROM (SELECT pushed, payload FROM example.data.late_mat ORDER BY ord LIMIT 30)
LIMIT 1;
records.replacement_sql:
SELECT
    array_element(regexp_match(pushed, 'in=([0-9]+)'), 1)::INT AS in_count,
    pushed NOT LIKE '%rng=none%' AS has_range
FROM (SELECT pushed, payload FROM example.data.late_mat ORDER BY ord LIMIT 30)
LIMIT 1;
records.reason: DataFusion returns regular-expression capture groups as a list; selecting its one-based first capture preserves DuckDB regexp_extract(..., 1) for the worker's pushdown witness.
